Hi Anna — thanks for the clear note and for the attachment. Looping in Connor (AP integration) and Kimberly (billing ops) so we can coordinate the handoff.

Short answers up front:
- Yes — we can push invoices to your AP portal via webhook. We support a signed HMAC header and retries with idempotency keys.
- Yes — we can also send a PDF copy to a designated mailbox the same day.
- Yes — invoices will contain a Tax ID field and VAT tags if you need them visible for reconciliation.

A couple of options to choose from (we usually pick one primary path + a fallback):
1) Portal-first: Redwood pushes the canonical invoice to your endpoint at creation time; we also deliver a PDF copy to procurements@sonderhealth.com (same timestamp).
2) Email-first with portal mirroring: Redwood emails the PDF and also POSTs the invoice payload to your portal asynchronously (longer delivery window).

We recommend option 1 for auditability (portal canonical + email copy). I've attached a sample invoice payload (redwood-invoice-sample.xml) so your AP team can confirm PO matching & VAT tag placement.

Next steps to finalize:
- Confirm which option you prefer (portal-first is our suggested default).
- Provide a test endpoint URL + auth header details (HMAC secret or bearer token).
- Confirm remittance info to appear on the invoice (bank details / address for payments).
- Let us know whether you need consolidated monthly PDF bundles in addition to individual invoice emails.

If you want, we can run a test invoice on July 16 and verify receipt and PO-matching.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Billing Ops — Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
